data.name: AccountNotFound
data.value: This account could not be found.

data.name: BackupNotFound
data.value: This backup could not be found.

data.name: BackupStillRunning
data.value: This backup is still being made and cannot be deleted yet.

data.name: BackupStreamDropped
data.value: The connection to the server agent was lost while the backup was being made.

data.name: BackupStreamIdle
data.value: The server agent stopped reporting progress while the backup was being made.

data.name: BackupTruncated
data.value: The server agent stopped without saying how the backup ended.

data.name: BackupCancelled
data.value: The backup was cancelled before it finished.

data.name: BackupInvalidOutcome
data.value: The server agent reported a finished backup with nothing to identify it by.

data.name: FinalBackupFailed
data.value: The account was not deleted: its final backup could not be made.

data.name: BackupNotRestorable
data.value: This backup cannot be restored: it did not finish successfully.

data.name: RestoreConfirmationRequired
data.value: Type the account's user name exactly to confirm the restore.

data.name: RestoreConfirmationMismatch
data.value: The name you typed is not this account's user name.

data.name: RestorePartial
data.value: The restore did not replace everything it set out to; the account is only partly restored.

data.name: RestoreStreamDropped
data.value: The connection to the server agent was lost while the account was being restored.

data.name: RestoreStreamIdle
data.value: The server agent stopped reporting progress while the account was being restored.

data.name: RestoreTruncated
data.value: The server agent stopped without saying what the restore had done.

data.name: RestoreCancelled
data.value: The restore was cancelled before it finished.

data.name: RestoreInvalidOutcome
data.value: The server agent reported a finished restore without saying what it restored.

data.name: BackupScheduleNotFound
data.value: This server has no backup schedule yet.

data.name: BackupScheduleHourOutOfRange
data.value: The hour must be between 0 and 23.

data.name: BackupScheduleRetainOutOfRange
data.value: The number of backups to keep must be between 1 and 365.

data.name: BackupScheduleDayRequired
data.value: A weekly schedule must name the day of the week it runs on.

data.name: BackupScheduleDayNotAllowed
data.value: A daily schedule cannot name a day of the week.

data.name: BackupScheduledRunAborted
data.value: The scheduled backup stopped before the server agent reported how it ended.

data.name: BackupDestinationNotFound
data.value: That backup destination does not exist.

data.name: BackupDestinationNotConfigured
data.value: This server has no default backup destination, so nothing can be backed up until it is reconciled at the next start.

data.name: BackupDestinationRemoteUnsupported
data.value: This build stores backups on this server only. S3-compatible storage is not available.

data.name: BackupDestinationLocalAlreadyDefined
data.value: This server already has its local backup destination, and it can have only one.

data.name: BackupDestinationNameInvalid
data.value: A backup destination needs a name of at most 64 characters.

data.name: RestoreArtifactRejected
data.value: Your server refused this copy: what it holds is not what the panel recorded when the copy was made. Nothing was restored and the account is unchanged. Restore from another copy, or contact support — this cannot be resolved by submitting the same request again.

data.name: AccountBackupOperationRunning
data.value: Your server is still working on another backup or restore for this account. Nothing was changed. Try again once that operation has finished.

data.name: BackupOutcomeUnobserved
data.value: The panel stopped following this backup before your server reported a result, so it cannot say whether the copy was finished. It is recorded as failed and is not offered for restore. Start a new backup, and contact support if this keeps happening.

data.name: RestoreOutcomeUnobserved
data.value: The panel stopped following this restore before your server reported a result, so it cannot say how far it got. The account may already have been replaced: check its files and databases before starting another restore, and contact support if you are unsure.

data.name: BackupArtifactUnvouched
data.value: The panel stopped following this backup before your server reported a result. A copy of that backup IS on your server, but the panel never recorded its checksum, so it cannot verify the copy and will not offer it for restore. It is recorded as failed and the copy was not deleted — ask support to release the space, or start a new backup.
